page_title: STR 1-1 MAR | Strasbourg v Marseille 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Yellow card. Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
89' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
86' It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.
85' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Substitution. Iliman Ndiaye makes way for Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
84' It will be a substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) is ready to enter the pitch as Junior Mwanga walks off.
84' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Habib Diarra is replaced by Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg).
83' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Delaine.
83' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
81' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Pau Lopez stops the ball from going inside right post.
77' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
76' An attempted cross from Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) is cleared.
75' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
74' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is cleared by the defence.
73' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

72' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
71' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
69' Substitution. Emanuel Emegha leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg).
69' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) replacing Amine Harit.
69' That will be all from Vitinha who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille).
68' Amine Harit (Marseille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
68' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' The ball is out of play. Marseille win a corner kick.
65' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
64' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
62' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:3.

59' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg). He steered the ball towards the bottom left corner, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
58' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Strasbourg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

58' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Pau Lopez thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
56' Gennaro Gattuso decides to make a substitution. Joaquin Correa will be replaced by Ismaila Sarr (Marseille).
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch so that Angelo can be given a rest.
54' Renan Lodi (Marseille) receives a yellow card for infringement.
54' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) steps up to send the ball in.
52' Amine Harit (Marseille) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
50' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Great teamplay by Strasbourg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
46' Referee Jerome Brisard blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
44' Marseille win a corner.
43' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:8.
39' The free kick from long range, taken by Marseille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
35' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Marseille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
32' Rough tackle by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the right post. It's 1:1.
25' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
20' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Joaquin Correa (Marseille) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the right side of the goal, but Matz Sels pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
19' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
18' Renan Lodi (Marseille) serves up a nice cross, but Matz Sels punches the ball away.
15' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) works the corner short.
14' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
14' Vitinha (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Matz Sels leaps like a salmon to deny him.
11' 26:74 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
9' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
6' 1 - 0 Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
4' Good movement by Angelo (Strasbourg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
3' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Matz Sels makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
2' Vitinha (Marseille) controls the ball after receiving a cross, but he slices his shot well wide of the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jerome Brisard.
